entities.summary: Sugar Revolution and the Plantation System, a transformative movement in Haiti (1697–1770). Emerged from Treaty of Ryswick 1697 cedes western Hispaniola to France and Treaty of Ryswick. Catalyzed Enslaved Population, Vodou, and Resistance and Gens de Couleur Libres and Colonial Social Hierarchy.
